data.name: Nuran
data.gender_notes: Nuran is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Nur’, meaning ‘light’. In Islam, ‘Nur’ is also used to describe the light of God. This name signifies guidance and illumination. The name Nuran carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuran usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nuran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuran total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نوران
in_arabic.meaning: نوران تعني الضوء و النور و الإشراق
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوران هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني الضوء و النور و الإشراق. و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم و لها دلالة على النور و الهداية. و يعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية لما يحمله من معاني جميلة و رفيعة.

in_urdu.name: نوران
in_urdu.meaning: نوران کا مطلب ہے روشنی اور نور
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوران ایک علم کا نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے روشنی اور نور۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور اس کی دلالت نور اور ہدایت پر ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام خوبصورت اور بلند معانی کے حامل ہونے کی وجہ سے پسند کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नूरान
in_hindi.meaning: नूरान का अर्थ है प्रकाश और नूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूरान एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है प्रकाश और नूर। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है और इसकी دلالت प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन पर है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी सुंदर और उच्च अर्थों के कारण पसंद किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نوران
in_pashto.meaning: نوران د رڼا او نور معنی لري

in_english.name: Nuran
in_english.long_meaning: Nuran is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning light and radiance. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'ن-و-ر' (n-w-r), which is also the root of the word 'nur', meaning light. This name is mentioned in the Quran and symbolizes guidance and illumination. In Islamic tradition, Nuran is considered a beautiful and noble name, reflecting the values of spirituality and enlightenment. The name is popular across various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Turkish, Urdu, and South Asian communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name ‘Nuran’ is a popular one in the Islamic world, with various spellings depending on the language and dialect. In Turkey, it is often spelled as ‘Nurhan’, and in Central Asia, it can also be found as ‘Nuron’. This name holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic societies, as it reminds us of the importance of light and guidance in our daily lives. In various Islamic literatures, poetry and songs, the name ‘Nuran’ evokes feelings of longing for divine guidance and the beauty of the Islamic faith. Some Muslims may also associate ‘Nuran’ with purity and innocence, as the root word ‘Nur’ signifies clarity and illumination.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name ‘Nuran’ is rooted in the fundamental Islamic belief that God is the source of all light and guidance. When used as a personal name, it serves as a reminder to the bearer that they should constantly seek the light of God and strive to live a virtuous life in accordance with Islamic teachings. The name also reinforces the idea that the guidance of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is a source of illumination and inspiration for Muslims. Ultimately, the name ‘Nuran’ reflects the belief that true cultural richness and spiritual growth are inseparable, and that the pursuit of both will lead to a more fulfilling and meaningful life.
